provenance.host: macOS (darwin), Apple Silicon — NOT the §8 reference environment (Linux, 8 vCPU, 16GiB, SSD)
provenance.note: Absolute numbers are only comparable on the same host and toolchain. §8 says a Mac report must be labelled as such and must not be presented as the reference environment's numbers; this file follows that rule. The gate's job is to catch a regression on the SAME machine, which is what the threshold applies to.
